data.gender_notes: Kimber is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kimber is derived from the Old English words kyne (kin) and beor (bright, shining). It originally meant ‘royal, noble, and pure.’ This name has been used in the English-speaking world since the Middle Ages and was popularized during the Victorian era. The name Kimber carries the meaning “Royal, noble, and pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kimber usually hope their child will grow to embody royal, noble, and pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kimber belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Royal, noble, and pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kimber total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
